d: Long, straight silver-grey hair with a side-swept fringe and a small bun at the back accompanies narrow, golden-yellow eyes with a sultry expression. Appearing as a mature adult, the figure has a slender yet curvy build, wearing a short black lace-trimmed slip dress under a long, oversized crimson red robe, paired with sheer black tights and black loafers. A thin black choker with a small red ornament adorns the neck, and the person is holding a black smartphone and a black shopping bag with white calligraphy.
